title: GTFS-RT VehiclePositions without `start_date` are not processed by OTP

labels.name: IBI
labels.description: Developed by or important for IBI Group

body:
## Expected behavior

A GTFS-RT vehicle position feed without `start_date` should still be processed, assuming that the vehicle is moving in the current moment, at the current date.

There is a bit of wiggle room as to how this should be handled. `ServiceDate` has a constructor to use the current server date, but it is deprecated as the feed time may not match the server time. This makes sense (although when using the deprecated method locally I get correct report times). However, there are many GTFS-RT feeds which do not report `start_date`, and these feeds should still be processable by OTP!

## Observed behavior

https://github.com/opentripplanner/OpenTripPlanner/blob/b2c0e9a317d7c098d86f614a28ad2f476eb1be29/src/main/java/org/opentripplanner/updater/vehicle_positions/VehiclePositionPatternMatcher.java#L122-L124

An error is thrown and the vehicle position report is not processed.

## Version of OTP used (exact commit hash or JAR name)

`b0c9829e3bfe10daddae72485a09a7f48b0be8ff` (latest dev)

## Data sets in use (links to GTFS and OSM PBF files)

GTFS: https://www.rtd-denver.com/files/gtfs/google_transit.zip
GTFS-RT vehicle positions: https://www.rtd-denver.com/files/gtfs-rt/VehiclePosition.pb

## Router config and graph build config JSON
```
updaters: [
    {
      "type": "vehicle-positions",
      "sourceType": "gtfs-http",
      "url": "https://www.rtd-denver.com/files/gtfs-rt/VehiclePosition.pb",
      "feedId": "1",
      "frequencySec": 60
    },
]
}
```

## Steps to reproduce the problem
Run OTP with this realtime feed and observe the many failures logged (claiming that "start_data" is missing). Also note that the GraphQL api does not report any realtime vehicles present for any routes, although there are realtime trip updates with valid trip IDs.

Ref: #3981
